summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward extreme long-term bullishness in the semiconductor sector and massive, high-strike index speculation. The dominant pattern is aggressive call accumulation in AMD (380C and 450C exp 2026) and INTC (88k/89kC exp 2026) totaling over $1B in premium, alongside massive SPX 7000C bets. Persistent interest is evident in the SPX 7000C (exp 2026 and 2029) and SPX 8000P (exp 2026) positions, which have seen hundreds of millions in continuous accumulation, signaling a "moonshot" directional bias for the broad market. Traders should watch for volatility in AMD and INTC as these massive LEAPS-driven premiums could force market makers to hedge aggressively, and monitor SPX for any breakdown that threatens the massive 7000C/8000P long-term structures.
